definitions.gloss: volunteer fire corps; community fire brigade
definitions.explanation: A locally organized body of resident volunteers who assist with firefighting, disaster response, and prevention alongside the professional fire service. Formed from {消防|しょうぼう} (firefighting) and {団|だん} (group, corps).

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{消防団|しょうぼうだん}に{入|はい}っている。
examples.english: My father belongs to the volunteer fire corps.

examples.japanese: {消防団|しょうぼうだん}が{地域|ちいき}の{防災訓練|ぼうさいくんれん}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: The volunteer fire corps carried out a disaster-prevention drill for the community.

examples.japanese: {地方|ちほう}では、{消防団|しょうぼうだん}が{住民|じゅうみん}の{安全|あんぜん}を{支|ささ}える{大切|たいせつ}な{存在|そんざい}だ。
examples.english: In rural areas, the volunteer fire corps is an important presence supporting residents' safety.

notes:
Members are ordinary residents who train and turn out part-time, distinct from the full-time staff of a {消防署|しょうぼうしょ}. Especially important in rural areas with few professional stations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消防団|しょうぼうだん}に{入|はい}る: to join the volunteer fire corps
- {消防団|しょうぼうだん}の{団員|だんいん}: a member of the fire corps
- {消防団|しょうぼうだん}の{活動|かつどう}: fire corps activities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {消防署|しょうぼうしょ}: fire station — staffed by professional, full-time firefighters.
- {消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}: firefighter — a paid professional, not a volunteer.
